scene.ko: 원어민 교사와 목요일 수업의 짝 활동을 정하고, 누가 어떤 자료를 준비할지 나눈다.

lines.en: Do you have a few minutes to plan Thursday's lesson?
lines.ko: 목요일 수업 계획할 시간 좀 있으세요?
alt: Can we plan Thursday's lesson now?
Do you have time to talk about Thursday's class?

lines.en: Sure. We're on Unit 4, giving directions, right?
lines.ko: 그럼요. 4단원 길 안내하기 할 차례 맞죠?

lines.en: Right. I was thinking we could do a map activity in pairs.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 짝끼리 지도 활동을 하면 어떨까 생각했어요.
alt: Yes. How about a pair activity with a map?
That's right. I'd like to try a map activity in pairs.

lines.en: I love that. I can make a simple town map with a few buildings.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 건물 몇 개 있는 간단한 마을 지도는 제가 만들 수 있어요.

lines.en: Great. Then I'll prepare the vocabulary cards for the warm-up.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 그럼 저는 도입 활동에 쓸 단어 카드를 준비할게요.
alt: Perfect. I'll make the word cards for the warm-up, then.
Great. Then I'll take care of the vocabulary cards.

lines.en: How long should the map activity be?
About fifteen minutes. Some students need extra time, so let's keep it simple.
lines.ko: 15분 정도요. 시간이 더 필요한 학생들도 있으니까 간단하게 해요.
alt: Around fifteen minutes. Some kids need more time, so let's keep it easy.

lines.en: Sounds good. Could you check the map before I print it?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 출력하기 전에 지도 한번 봐 주실래요?

lines.en: Sure. Just send it to me by Wednesday.
alt: Of course. Please send it to me by Wednesday.
No problem. Email it to me by Wednesday.

expressions.en: Do you have a few minutes to ___?
